A thick, cream-colored book spine with a gold label, positioned next to a page of text.

Woodcut illustration of a tree with grapes and leaves surrounding a central medallion of two figures, with a banner reading 'ALS' at the base.

Title page of 'Le vinti giornate dell'agricoltura' by M. Agostino Gallo, printed in Venetia in 1625, with a central female figure engraving.
